messages:
alexandra: Hi team — planning my phased return after parental leave. Hoping to go 60% FTE for 12 weeks starting 2026-05-10. Question on benefits/leave paperwork (do I need to re-enroll or is it auto?), payroll code for part-time, and whether the company can ship a lightweight dock+monitor to my home since I'll be remote 3 days/week. Also need help coordinating on-call coverage weeks 2-6 while I ramp.
people-ops: Congrats again! :tada: You can do a temporary part-time return. Please submit the 'Phased Return' form here: https://hr.redwood.example/phased-return and select 60% for 12w. That triggers payroll and benefits workflows.
people-ops: Short answers: 1) Benefits continue — medical/dental remain active; premium proration handled by payroll. 2) Payroll will apply a temp FTE code. 3) We can ship gear — send a shipping address on the form.
maria: Thanks for the heads up @alexandra. I can cover the first two weeks of your on-call and pair with @samir to cover weeks 3-6. We'll post a temporary rota. Can you add your preferred working days so I can coordinate async meetings?
alexandra: thanks! Preferred days: Tue/Wed/Thu in-office or remote? I'd be remote Tue/Thu, in-office Wed. Mon/Fri off for childcare pickup.
samir: ok I'll pick up week 3 and 4 on-call. @people-ops can you add a note to the on-call rota that alex is on reduced hours so alerts get routed to backup after 10pm?
people-ops: noted. We have a routing policy snippet you can copy into the rota page: ```if user.fte < 1.0 then route_alerts_to_backup_after(22:00)``` — we'll add a visual flag.
michelle: Payroll note: code for this arrangement is PT60-2026. Please reference that on the form so benefits/proration flows correctly. Any equity vesting adjustments will be handled by comp ops; we'll notify you by email.
alexandra: do I need to complete any new FMLA docs or is that only for leave start? I'm worried about paperwork dragging the return.
people-ops: No extra FMLA docs for phased return if continuous leave record exists. If anything changes (longer than 12w or change in FTE) we'll ask for updated docs.
hr-bot: Reminder: submit the phased-return form within 10 business days to guarantee equipment shipping before start. Equipment requests typically take 7–12 business days.
alexandra: perfect. Quick Q on childcare subsidy — is that prorated for 60%?
michelle: Yes — childcare subsidy is pro-rated to FTE. We'll calculate the monthly subsidy based on PT60-2026 and payroll will reflect the adjusted amount. If you'd like a calc before you sign, DM me and I'll send the estimate.
maria: For coverage: suggestion — we onboard a short-term temp for 0.4 FTE to handle async work and PR reviews. @samir can you take point on the hiring ops request?
samir: Yep will spin up a short-term contract req today. ETA for candidate in 2 weeks. I'll tag people-ops for contractor onboarding checklist.
alexandra: last thing — lactation room scheduling? I might need guaranteed private slot on Weds mornings while I'm still feeding.
people-ops: We can reserve Weds 9–10am in the main lactation room for 12 weeks. Please confirm and we'll lock it in the room calendar.
alexandra: confirm please, that helps a ton. Thank you all. :heart:
people-ops: Next steps checklist for alexandra: 
- submit phased-return form (include PT60-2026)
- shipping address for home dock+monitor in form
- confirm lactation room slot (we'll lock it)
- manager (maria) to publish on-call rota + backup pairs
- samir to open contractor req for 0.4 FTE
We'll follow up via email with timelines once form is in.
michelle: I'll draft the payroll proration note and cc you, @alexandra, once PT60-2026 is attached.
alexandra: done — submitted form and added address. Thanks everyone!
people-ops: Received. Shipping window estimate: 8 business days. We'll ping here when shipped. :truck:
